ModMetaData.description:

RimSynapse - Living World
Brings inhabited maps to life. Where other mods count how many people a place should hold, Living World is what actually puts them there: homesteads and dwellings with residents who farm, cook, self-tend, forage in winter, and trade their surplus to passing traders — so the settlers you find on a map plausibly survive long enough to have built it.
Standalone. With RimSynapse - Regions and Territories installed, Living World reads its regional population model to decide where and how densely to place inhabitants. On its own it seeds a modest number of homesteads on habitable tiles from the world seed. It requires neither Regions and Territories nor Map Mode Framework.
Combat Extended is supported: when it is installed, residents are given the correct ammunition for their weapon. When it is not, nothing changes.
